item.title: Recall of Cpzzkq Baby Loungers Expanded Due to Risk Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Infant Support Cushions; Sold on Amazon by CetoPMax
item.company: Online at Amazon.com from May 2026 through June 2026 for between $30 to $50.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com from May 2026 through June 2026 for between $30 to $50.
item.summary: This recall involves an additional 195 Cpzzkq baby loungers sold in green and purple with "Model No: UMCDB01" printed on a stacked label located on the side of the lounger. Baby loungers in white, grayish blue, pink, zuma blue and brown were previously recalled in April 2026. All the recalled baby loungers are rectangular in shape, are made of a foam pad with a cloth cover and have "CPZZKQ" printed on a side label.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Cpzzkq Baby Loungers.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the baby loungers immediately and contact CetoPMax for a refund. Consumers will be asked to remove the foam and pad from the baby lounger's cover and cut the cover, foam and pad in half. Consumers should then email photos of the destroyed pieces to CetoPMaxRecall@outlook.com to receive a refund.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
